thesis: One falsifiable sentence describing your prediction.
invalidation: What would prove the thesis wrong, e.g. 'If tariff negotiations conclude without >5% rates by June 15'
exit_criteria: Target price, stop loss, or hold-to-resolution. E.g. 'Sell at 75¢ or cut loss at 15¢'

orders.rationale: Market at 32¢ bid/35¢ ask. Thesis implies >50% probability — 15-20¢ edge.
